about.description: Lighthouse is a beachfront condo vacation rental operated by Brett/Robinson Vacation Rentals, a family-owned and operated company with over 40 years of experience in Gulf Shores and Orange Beach, Alabama. The property offers quality accommodations with dedicated on-site customer service staff and area expertise.
